description:
Hey! We’re CosmiCore, an interdisciplinary student team of CS and cybersecurity builders. 👩‍💻

For this challenge, we're building an Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map, leveraging NASA's public datasets to map a selected Martian region and layer critical survival data, hazards, and mission intelligence onto an interactive layout. 🚀

If you like coding, data analysis, or spatial visualization, come join us! 🪐
